frontier.hypothesis: Residual B (5 insns): once C lands, the "r"(&sp_var) asm operand closes the LZCR slot addressing at 202 insns, leaving only the dist copy into $a0.
frontier.mechanism: an r-constrained address operand materialises the frame-slot address into a pseudo (confirmed this session at 203 insns); the remaining copy is a global.c coalescing question — dist stays live across the three calls in $s1 while the copy dies before them
